summary: The study investigates the formation and suppression of vertical nanostructures during plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) of WS2. The process involves a two-step (AB-type) PEALD process with an additional step (C) using either Ar plasma or H2 plasma. The addition of plasma steps significantly reduces the density of vertical nanostructures by 80%, leading to a substantial decrease in film resistivity. The suppression of vertical nanostructures is linked to grain size enhancement and other physicochemical effects.
